name: Jade & Pandora's Room
body:
One wall hums faintly with Pandora's servers glowing behind a secured alcove — racks, fans, and the Ghosts' digital archive casting soft light through the gap beneath the door. The other holds tournament medals above monitors, photos of the volleyball team and candid shots of Pandora lining the corkboard.

Spare cables coil in Pandora's drawers; Jade's hair ties tangle with them inevitably. Solid oak four-poster with a fold-out desk shelf in the headboard.

THEIR NIGHTS END THE SAME WAY — Pandora asleep against a glowing monitor, Jade draping her team jacket over those shoulders like she is tucking in the most brilliant girl she has ever known.
